topic: A person learns their favorite restaurant is closing
text: The news came on a day when the clouds seemed heavier, more laden with secrets than usual. I heard it from the edges of a conversation, a whisper that slipped out as I stood outside the place that once offered me more than just warm meals. It’s closing. The walls, which once held my stories, the laughter that clung to the air like a soft, invisible fog, will stand silent soon. I can’t help but linger, as if my presence might somehow weave a different ending. I trace the outline of the door, a portal to moments that felt endless, now counting down to a close. The street outside feels a little colder, the sun a bit farther away, as I walk away knowing the door will one day open no more.
